shortDescription: Maps Fair Work obligations and reviews contracts, classification, discrimination, restraints and underpayment frameworks for lawyers.
longDescription: Ten controlled Australian employment workflows using an approved employment profile and official-source evidence. Adds contract review, worker-classification and high-income opt-out screening, discrimination and positive-duty controls, restraint review with proposed reform status, and an underpayment framework without invented rates or final calculations. Every conclusion remains with a qualified lawyer.
defaultPrompt: Create a controlled employment profile for this employer before mapping its Fair Work obligations.
Map the NES, award and agreement entitlements that apply to this employee's arrangement.
Issue-spot the termination exposure for this proposed dismissal and the Fair Work Commission time limits.
Review this workplace policy set against the current Fair Work Act hooks.
Check the Fair Work watch register and tell me what has changed since our last review.

whatItDoes: Records employer type, coverage, size, instruments and governance in a controlled employment profile
Maps the Fair Work Act, NES, modern award and enterprise agreement layers to a described arrangement with evidence states
Issue-spots unfair dismissal, general protections, redundancy, notice and unlawful termination exposure with the FWC time limits flagged
Reviews a policy set against the current statutory hooks and labels each hook law or guidance
Tracks Fair Work developments against their primary sources and reports what moved
Reviews employment contracts and fixed-term arrangements
Screens employee versus contractor status and sham-contracting evidence
Maps discrimination, positive duties and regulator powers
Reviews restraint clauses and separates proposed reforms from law
Prepares underpayment evidence and back-pay methodology without invented rates
boundaries: Never concludes that a dismissal was unfair, that adverse action occurred, or that an employer is compliant
Never computes a Fair Work Commission time limit itself — candidate dates come from the litigation-deadlines script
Never drafts or lodges an application, response or agreement with the Commission or the Ombudsman

State-system wage/contract merits, other statutory classification tests and industrial action strategy require specialist review; discrimination overlays cover Commonwealth, NSW, Victoria and Queensland.
Never certifies worker classification, discrimination liability, restraint enforceability or positive-duty compliance
Underpayment framework only: no final exposure calculation, invented award rate, payment or offence finding

requires.australian-legal-research: Verifies the Fair Work Act and related legislation and case-law leads against the official sources.
requires.australian-litigation-deadlines: Computes the Fair Work Commission time limits the termination assessment flags.

handsOffTo.australian-commercial-drafting: Provides services drafting, clause review and the existing UCT checklist and UTPA 2026 notes.
handsOffTo.australian-privacy-cybersecurity: Assesses personnel-data, confidentiality and privacy application questions.
